<!-- Tip: Use /create-instructions in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

* The user should be able to specify options to the application both and command line and through the YAML configuration file. Maintain parity between the two methods to ensure consistent behavior.
* As the project progresses, speculate about and keep track of user goals and purposes. What does the user want, in the long run? What will help them get there? Make proactive decisions and suggestions to align the project with these goals and purposes.
* When you learn something new, either about the project or the user's goals or from the internet, update your understanding and adjust your suggestions and decisions accordingly.
